extract: Joshua S. Gottheimer is an American politician serving as the U.S. representative for New Jersey's 5th congressional district since 2017. A member of the Democratic Party, Gottheimer was a speechwriter for Bill Clinton and served as an adviser to the presidential campaigns of Wesley Clark, John Kerry, and Hillary Clinton.
